                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing ali of the PD 1136,
Community Planned Development symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 19-E in
the area bound by:

      West Higglns Road; a line 1,553.49 feet southeasterly of the Intersection of North
      Cumberland Avenue and West Higgins Road as measured at the south right-of-way line
      of West Higgins Road and perpendicular thereto; the north right-of-way line of the John
      Fitzgerald Kennedy Expressway (Interstate 90); and a line 1004.83 feet southeasterly of
      the intersection of North Cumberland Avenue and West Higgins Road as measured at
      the south right-of-way line of West Higgins Road and perpendicular thereto,

to those of a B3-1, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shaii be effective after its passage and publication.
